verdict.rationale: Kling documents native audio co-generation that includes speech (Kling 2.6), a 'with audio + voice control' generation tier, and persistent character voice through the Elements system, so generated characters can plausibly speak supplied dialogue. However, no evidence explicitly describes lip movement synchronized to that audio. missing for 10: explicit documentation of lip-sync quality or a lip-sync feature, support for lip-syncing user-uploaded dialogue audio, independent or hands-on corroboration.
